units.rawText: ...Oh, it's you, Professor. Are you here to stimulate your memory? I'm not sure how that works, considering we met after you lost your memory.
units.displayText: ...Oh, it's you, Professor. Are you here to stimulate your memory? I'm not sure how that works, considering we met after you lost your memory.

spans.text: ...Oh, it's you, Professor. Are you here to stimulate your memory? I'm not sure how that works, considering we met after you lost your memory.

units.rawText: I'm not entirely sure either. But I believe that communicating with more Dolls might help piece together the bigger picture, which could aid in restoring my memory.
units.displayText: I'm not entirely sure either. But I believe that communicating with more Dolls might help piece together the bigger picture, which could aid in restoring my memory.

spans.text: I'm not entirely sure either. But I believe that communicating with more Dolls might help piece together the bigger picture, which could aid in restoring my memory.

units.rawText: Sigh... Our first meeting wasn't anything sweet to begin with though.
units.displayText: Sigh... Our first meeting wasn't anything sweet to begin with though.

spans.text: Sigh... Our first meeting wasn't anything sweet to begin with though.

units.rawText: Hm? Are you referring to when you interrogated me? I was genuinely thankful that you asked the question everyone was too hesitant to ask.
units.displayText: Hm? Are you referring to when you interrogated me? I was genuinely thankful that you asked the question everyone was too hesitant to ask.

spans.text: Hm? Are you referring to when you interrogated me? I was genuinely thankful that you asked the question everyone was too hesitant to ask.

units.rawText: You are such a... you say that, but you never meant to reveal your true identity from the start!
units.displayText: You are such a... you say that, but you never meant to reveal your true identity from the start!

spans.text: You are such a... you say that, but you never meant to reveal your true identity from the start!

units.rawText: Another battle awaits me in the real world. Revealing my identity could put others at a disadvantage, and that's a risk I cannot take.
units.displayText: Another battle awaits me in the real world. Revealing my identity could put others at a disadvantage, and that's a risk I cannot take.

spans.text: Another battle awaits me in the real world. Revealing my identity could put others at a disadvantage, and that's a risk I cannot take.

units.rawText: Sigh. Okay, I've already come to accept the issue surrounding your identity.
units.displayText: Sigh. Okay, I've already come to accept the issue surrounding your identity.

spans.text: Sigh. Okay, I've already come to accept the issue surrounding your identity.

units.rawText: I don't care who you really are in the real world. Here, you'll always be <cmdr>, the Professor of the Oasis—mysterious, suspicious, cunning, and someone with countless enemies...
units.displayText: I don't care who you really are in the real world. Here, you'll always be {교수}, the Professor of the Oasis—mysterious, suspicious, cunning, and someone with countless enemies...

, the Professor of the Oasis—mysterious, suspicious, cunning, and someone with countless enemies...

units.rawText: You always act tough, showing a kind face no matter what whilst taking everything on your own shoulders... and for reasons beyond me, you also possess uncanny luck with women.
units.displayText: You always act tough, showing a kind face no matter what whilst taking everything on your own shoulders... and for reasons beyond me, you also possess uncanny luck with women.

spans.text: You always act tough, showing a kind face no matter what whilst taking everything on your own shoulders... and for reasons beyond me, you also possess uncanny luck with women.

units.rawText: Antonina, the labels you plaster me with seem to be growing day by day...
units.displayText: Antonina, the labels you plaster me with seem to be growing day by day...

spans.text: Antonina, the labels you plaster me with seem to be growing day by day...

units.rawText: And who else is to blame for that? I admit, your identity and your purpose intrigue me, but we both know this is not the time. My view of you remains unchanged, no matter who you are.
units.displayText: And who else is to blame for that? I admit, your identity and your purpose intrigue me, but we both know this is not the time. My view of you remains unchanged, no matter who you are.

spans.text: And who else is to blame for that? I admit, your identity and your purpose intrigue me, but we both know this is not the time. My view of you remains unchanged, no matter who you are.

units.rawText: And as compensation for deceiving us for so long, <cmdr>, your sentence is to introduce yourself truthfully, in the most detailed way possible, once we're out of the Cloud.

units.rawText: Until then, you can continue playing your role as the Oasis' Professor worry-free. And I, as always, will do my best to fulfill your ridiculous requests.
